play_name: Check what the ring is doing for you now
behavioral_target: Still wearing a ring from a relationship that has ended.
trigger: The relationship is over, but you keep putting your ring on each day.
function_of_old_play: Wearing it keeps part of the bond close, so it feels like you have not fully let go.
new_play: Notice why the ring stays on right now. If it comforts you while you grieve, that is okay. If it keeps you from facing the loss, try setting it aside for a set time and watch how each day feels.
what_to_expect: Taking it off, even for a little while, can bring up sad or lonely feelings.
why_supports_task: Learning whether the ring helps you grieve or holds you back gives the hurt room to move, which is the work of healing.
maintaining_behaviors_consolidated: Continuing to wear a ring from a relationship that has ended.
context_limitations: There is no set clock for grief. Wearing a ring to honor someone you loved or lost can be healthy. This is about your own healing, not a rule.
review_reason: Recovery phase has no competencies in the framework (source gap); the alternative is a context-dependent observation move grounded only in the Healing task. Grief-sensitive: wearing the ring may be adaptive, so the move stays conditional.
